archive_policy.meaning: Archive none of the seven while Patrick's 2026-09-15 cross-dependency hold remains in force. This is not a claim that all seven are retirement targets.

semantic_atlas_projection.rule: Provider projection does not replace Semantic Atlas Git source authority.

repositories.vcp_responsibility: Track exact promoted Vera-scoped source objects and own install/current-route/qualification control; do not copy whole sexuality research corpus.

repositories.transition_rule: A successor subject or explicit reviewed rebind must bind the exact accepted Vera source. Mirroring the historical V1 subject preserves provenance and transfers no PASS.

repositories.vcp_responsibility: Track promoted executable/control subjects only; keep Patrick-specific research private and external.
Do not become conation-history storage. Control only future promoted runtime/install/qualification artifacts if such mechanisms are introduced.
Track source/provider generation used by Vera releases; provider projection remains derived research staging.
Track promoted exact asset/canon/control receipts when needed; do not absorb binaries, donor registry, geometry workspace or provenance estate.
No specialist content ownership. Track only any release/install consequences of Vera's internal temporal implementation; standalone history is preserved in Vera source.
